correctness.rationale: For P(n)=n(n+1)(2n+1)/6 and a=563,b=11, square-cobalancing is precisely 574P(n)=11P(n+r). Direct integer evaluation gives P(5)=55, P(20)=2870, P(142)=964535, P(532)=50331190, so 574·55=11·2870=31570 and 574·964535=11·50331190=553643090; r=15,390. gcd(563,11)=1 and both indices >1. Setting X=2n+1,Y=2(n+r)+1 gives 11Y(Y²−1)=574X(X²−1) and rational integral points (11,41), (285,1065). Homogenized cubic is nonsingular: at Z=0 derivatives imply X=Y=0, impossible; for Z≠0 derivatives impose X²=Y²=Z²/3 and 11Y=574X, a contradiction. Thus smooth plane genus-one curve with rational point. The bounded scan n≤10000 in checker cannot prove global completeness, which is not claimed.
